one_liner: Cloud-hosted collaborative spreadsheet and database platform for organizing work and building apps.
auth_notes: Airtable supports both Personal Access Tokens and OAuth 2.0 access tokens passed via Bearer token authorization header.
access_notes: Free tier is available to sign up and test via self-serve developer credentials.
api_notes: REST API covering bases, tables, records, fields, and webhooks under api.airtable.com/v0.
blocker_notes: Public API is accessible with self-serve credentials and an official MCP server is provided.

auth.quote: We currently support using personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens during the authentication process.

access.quote: Free Access to all "Base Data" endpoints except "Views" Public API limit is enforced.

api.quote: The Airtable API can be used to integrate your data in Airtable with any external system. The API closely follows REST semantics

mcp.quote: The Airtable MCP server gives agents your base's full structure — field types, relationships, and views — so they can make context-aware decisions.

verdict.quote: Any MCP-compatible tool can read, write, and query your bases through natural language, scoped to your existing permissions.
